Helmut Lotti more candid than ever in documentary: on global success, three divorces, and a secret marriage.

Helmut, More Than Lotti is a two-part documentary that offers an intimate and candid look at Belgian singer Helmut Lotti after more than 30 years of international success. It retraces his journey from his breakthrough in the Soundmixshow to the global phenomenon of Helmut Lotti Goes Classic, while also revealing the personal cost of fame.

Beyond the highlights of his career, the documentary focuses on the man behind the artist. Lotti opens up about the pressures of his public image, his struggle to break free from expectations, and the turning points that shaped his musical direction.

It also dives deeply into his private life, where he speaks honestly about his three divorces and their emotional and financial impact, as well as revealing for the first time his long-kept secret marriage.

Through personal reflections and contributions from key people around him, the series paints a nuanced portrait of an artist searching for balance between fame, identity, and personal happiness.
